notes: Self-declared as an obby and the activity is player-paced platforming, so Obby & Platformer leads and owns the genre-wide P6; Puzzle is named second because the echoes press buttons and open doors, and only Puzzle can express button-solve and the gates, which would otherwise be invisible for the whole run. Shape is course-tower from the intake answer asking for a compact vertical climb where echoes visibly cross above and below the player — that overhang is stated outright, so the shape's P2 is earned rather than assumed. Took Tower Obby and added the two Puzzle gates plus obstacle-moving, since the past-run echoes acting as moving platforms and blockers is exactly that option; hazard-kill stays off because the dark void surrounding the floating platforms means failure is falling, which is the genre's normal failure state. Without a user I judged that 'infinite procedurally generated stages' means one tower regenerated per attempt rather than several maps co-existing, so no P4, and that the AI Director rebuilding sections at runtime is a mechanics system sitting on top of the layout, which the P6 procedural-first build order already accommodates.
